# Carousel

Slides that move left and right, one or a few at a time.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** Moves through campaign images.

- **Use it when:** A few images or items people browse for pleasure, where missing some is fine.
- **Not when:** Content people must see: most never reach the later slides.

Instead:

- [Card](./card.md): A grid shows every item at once.

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Accessibility and keyboard

| Keyboard | What happens | Not |
| --- | --- | --- |
| undefined | Arrow keys move between slides when the carousel has focus. | undefined |

Test before you ship:

- [ ] Previous and next are buttons with names; nothing moves on its own without a pause control. undefined

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add carousel
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.

## Tokens it reads

Carousel sets no colors, corners or shadows of its own; it takes them from the components inside it.
